annotation.authors_or_issuer: Japan (National Diet; National Police Agency administration)
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines 特定自動運行 (specified automated operation) using automated driving systems under the Road Transport Vehicle Act, excluding it from conventional 'driving'.
Chapter 4-3 establishes a permit system for specified automated operation (Arts. 75-12 to 75-29).
Chapter 2-2 requires users of remotely operated small vehicles (delivery robots) to notify the Public Safety Commission, display registration numbers, and accept inspections and instructions.
Remotely operated small vehicles must have emergency stop devices, yield to pedestrians, and be operated at safe speeds.
Penalties, administrative fines and licence sanctions are defined for traffic violations.
annotation.summary_en: Japan's Road Traffic Act (Act No. 105 of 1960), current version enforced 21 July 2026. It governs road traffic, licensing and penalties. It includes provisions on level-4 'specified automated operation' permits and on remotely operated small vehicles such as delivery robots, covering notification, marking, inspection and emergency stop devices.
